compiled_state.title: [Outbound Bridge]: WORKTREE_TRACKING comment not filtered -> internal marker leaked to Jira
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 0c26228c77e3322b10a488eb32ef037ca16a127c

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

WORKTREE_TRACKING comments are internal, local-only operational annotations (see plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md and plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/worktree-dispatch.md). Outbound bridge should filter these from Jira sync.

#### Actual Behavior

DIG-1646 contains a Jira comment whose body is the internal `WORKTREE_TRACKING:start` marker, posted by the outbound bridge.
